vocabulary_groups.title: Final board sections
vocabulary_groups.description: Core words for naming the parts of the mini design board.

items.definition_en: A page or board that shows a design idea with image and text.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A board that shows the fashion idea.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma prancha que mostra a ideia de moda.
items.example_sentence_en: This design board shows one complete look.
items.example_sentence_pt: This design board shows one complete look.
items.professional_context_en: Design board is the final Week 14 artifact type.
items.professional_context_pt: Design board e o tipo de artefato final da Semana 14.
items.translation_notes_pt: Keep the English term visible and support with prancha de design.

items.definition_en: A short word or phrase that names one part of the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A short name on the board.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um nome curto na prancha.
items.example_sentence_en: Each label names one visible design feature.
items.example_sentence_pt: Each label names one visible design feature.
items.professional_context_en: Labels help organize garment, fabric, detail, and inspiration information.
items.professional_context_pt: Labels ajudam a organizar informacoes de peca, tecido, detalhe e inspiracao.
items.translation_notes_pt: Avoid over-translating; keep label as the main classroom term and bridge to rotulo only when needed.

items.definition_en: A short text that explains one part of the board.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A short sentence under or near the image.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma frase curta embaixo ou perto da imagem.
items.example_sentence_en: The caption explains the main detail.
items.example_sentence_pt: The caption explains the main detail.
items.professional_context_en: Caption language prepares students for portfolio-style presentation.
items.professional_context_pt: Caption prepara os alunos para uma apresentacao em estilo de portfolio.
items.translation_notes_pt: Bridge to legenda curta when needed.

items.definition_en: The complete visual effect of the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The full final impression of the look.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A impressao final completa do look.
items.example_sentence_en: The overall look is soft and elegant.
items.example_sentence_pt: The overall look is soft and elegant.
items.professional_context_en: Overall look gives students a simple way to close the board or presentation.
items.professional_context_pt: Overall look oferece uma forma simples de fechar a prancha ou a apresentacao.
items.translation_notes_pt: Bridge to visual geral or look geral, but keep the English phrase in output.

vocabulary_groups.title: Garments and parts review
vocabulary_groups.description: Recycled garment and part vocabulary needed for the final board.

items.definition_en: A piece of clothing.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: One clothing item.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma peca de roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: The garment is a long dress.
items.example_sentence_pt: The garment is a long dress.
items.professional_context_en: Garment is useful when the board needs one general fashion word.
items.professional_context_pt: Garment e util quando a prancha precisa de uma palavra geral de moda.

items.definition_en: The shape or edge around the neck area of a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The neck part of the clothing.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte do pescoco da roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: The neckline is round and simple.
items.example_sentence_pt: The neckline is round and simple.
items.professional_context_en: Neckline is a common visible feature for board labels and detail notes.
items.professional_context_pt: Neckline e uma caracteristica visivel comum para labels e notas de detalhe.
items.translation_notes_pt: Bridge to decote, but keep the English term active.

items.definition_en: The part of a garment that covers the arm.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The arm part of the clothing.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte do braco da roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: The dress has short sleeves.
items.example_sentence_pt: The dress has short sleeves.
items.professional_context_en: Sleeve supports visible description and label matching.
items.professional_context_pt: Sleeve apoia descricao visivel e correspondencia de labels.

items.definition_en: The lower edge of a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The bottom edge of the clothing.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A borda de baixo da roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: The hem is below the knee.
items.example_sentence_pt: The hem is below the knee.
items.professional_context_en: Hem helps students label length and shape more precisely.
items.professional_context_pt: Hem ajuda os alunos a marcar comprimento e forma com mais precisao.

vocabulary_groups.title: Fabric and texture review
vocabulary_groups.description: Recycled terms for fabric choice and texture description.

items.definition_en: The material used to make the garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The material of the clothing.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O material da roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: I imagine this garment in a soft fabric.
items.example_sentence_pt: I imagine this garment in a soft fabric.
items.professional_context_en: Fabric is one of the main explanation sections in the final board.
items.professional_context_pt: Fabric e uma das principais secoes de explicacao na prancha final.

items.definition_en: The outside shape of the garment or look.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The main outside shape.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A forma principal externa.
items.example_sentence_en: The silhouette is loose and long.
items.example_sentence_pt: The silhouette is loose and long.
items.professional_context_en: Silhouette connects sketch description to the final integrated board.
items.professional_context_pt: Silhouette conecta a descricao do croqui a prancha final integrada.
items.translation_notes_pt: Do not replace with only a Portuguese word; keep pronunciation support visible.

items.definition_en: The set of colors used in the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The colors in the look.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: As cores do look.
items.example_sentence_en: The palette is calm and soft.
items.example_sentence_pt: The palette is calm and soft.
items.professional_context_en: Palette is central for color explanation in the final board.
items.professional_context_pt: Palette e central para a explicacao de cor na prancha final.
items.translation_notes_pt: Avoid over-translating; keep the English fashion term active.

items.definition_en: Not heavy; light in feel.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Light and not heavy.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Leve e nao pesado.
items.example_sentence_en: The fabric looks lightweight and flowy.
items.example_sentence_pt: The fabric looks lightweight and flowy.
items.professional_context_en: Lightweight helps students describe fabric quality more precisely.
items.professional_context_pt: Lightweight ajuda os alunos a descrever a qualidade do tecido com mais precisao.

vocabulary_groups.title: Design details review
vocabulary_groups.description: Words for naming visible details and their function or effect.

items.definition_en: One small feature that is important in the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: One small important part.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma parte pequena e importante.
items.example_sentence_en: The main detail is the embroidery.
items.example_sentence_pt: The main detail is the embroidery.
items.professional_context_en: Detail supports the final board line about visible design choices.
items.professional_context_pt: Detail apoia a linha final da prancha sobre escolhas visiveis de design.
items.translation_notes_pt: Keep the English term active and bridge to detalhe when needed.
items.pronunciation_notes: Say DEE-tail or di-TAIL, but keep one classroom model.

items.definition_en: Decorative stitching on fabric.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Decorative thread design on the fabric.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Desenho decorativo com linha no tecido.
items.example_sentence_en: The embroidery adds texture and color.
items.example_sentence_pt: The embroidery adds texture and color.
items.professional_context_en: Embroidery is a useful visible detail for board labels and model text.
items.professional_context_pt: Embroidery e um detalhe visivel util para labels e texto-modelo da prancha.

items.definition_en: Useful for how the garment works.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Helpful for use, not only for style.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Util para o uso, nao apenas para o estilo.
items.example_sentence_en: The zipper is functional because it opens the jacket.
items.example_sentence_pt: The zipper is functional because it opens the jacket.
items.professional_context_en: Functional helps students explain why one detail matters.
items.professional_context_pt: Functional ajuda os alunos a explicar por que um detalhe importa.

items.definition_en: Used mainly for visual effect or beauty.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Used to make the design look nicer.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Usado para deixar o design mais bonito visualmente.
items.example_sentence_en: The embroidery is decorative because it adds color.
items.example_sentence_pt: The embroidery is decorative because it adds color.
items.professional_context_en: Decorative helps students describe why a visible feature is there.
items.professional_context_pt: Decorative ajuda os alunos a descrever por que uma caracteristica visivel esta ali.

vocabulary_groups.title: Inspiration and mood review
vocabulary_groups.description: Words and phrases for explaining the idea behind the design.

items.definition_en: Based on or influenced by something.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Getting the idea from something.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Ter a ideia a partir de algo.
items.example_sentence_en: This design is inspired by the ocean.
items.example_sentence_pt: This design is inspired by the ocean.
items.professional_context_en: Inspired by is the main frame for the board rationale.
items.professional_context_pt: Inspired by e a principal estrutura para a justificativa da prancha.
items.translation_notes_pt: Bridge to inspirado em, but keep the exact English phrase for output.

items.definition_en: A word used to give a reason.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A word for saying why.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma palavra para dizer por que.
items.example_sentence_en: I chose blue because it feels calm.
items.example_sentence_pt: I chose blue because it feels calm.
items.professional_context_en: Because is essential for explaining one design choice clearly.
items.professional_context_pt: Because e essencial para explicar claramente uma escolha de design.

items.definition_en: A phrase for naming one design choice.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A phrase for saying what I selected.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma frase para dizer o que eu escolhi.
items.example_sentence_en: I chose blue and white because they feel calm.
items.example_sentence_pt: I chose blue and white because they feel calm.
items.professional_context_en: I chose helps students explain personal design decisions in simple English.
items.professional_context_pt: I chose ajuda os alunos a explicar decisoes pessoais de design em ingles simples.

items.definition_en: To improve or change work after feedback.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: To fix or improve after comments.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Corrigir ou melhorar depois de comentarios.
items.example_sentence_en: I revise one sentence to make it clearer.
items.example_sentence_pt: I revise one sentence to make it clearer.
items.professional_context_en: Revise connects the final board to Week 13 feedback language.
items.professional_context_pt: Revise conecta a prancha final a linguagem de feedback da Semana 13.
items.translation_notes_pt: Bridge to revisar, but keep the English verb in student output.

vocabulary_groups.title: Feedback and revision review
vocabulary_groups.description: Recycled Week 13 language for final checklist and improvement work.

items.definition_en: Easier to understand than before.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: More easy to understand.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Mais facil de entender.
items.example_sentence_en: I revised the line to make it clearer.
items.example_sentence_pt: I revised the line to make it clearer.
items.professional_context_en: Clearer is useful for the revision comment and teacher feedback.
items.professional_context_pt: Clearer e util para o comentario de revisao e para o feedback do professor.

items.definition_en: The completed version after review and revision.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The finished version.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A versao final.
items.example_sentence_en: This is my final version of the mini design board.
items.example_sentence_pt: This is my final version of the mini design board.
items.professional_context_en: Final version helps students understand the difference between draft and submission.
items.professional_context_pt: Final version ajuda os alunos a entender a diferenca entre rascunho e envio final.
